description:
Fixes the Petal Maps 4.8.0.300 startup crash (NoSuchMethodError) and keeps the app working without HMS Core: WebView H5 login, no HMS dialog and no forced close.

- **Anti-Repack Bypass**: neutralises the native SecurityDetect.irpj() integrity check that kills the process on re-signed APKs.
- **Manufacturer Check Bypass**: removes the Huawei/Honor-only device gate, allowing Petal Maps to run on any Android device.
- **Huawei Login Fix**: forces the Account Picker sign-in path, which uses the WebView H5 fallback when HMS Core is missing.
- **Skip HMS Core checks**: suppresses the "HMS Core not installed" dialog and prevents the app from closing the map activity without HMS Core.
- **Change package name**: install alongside the original app (default: morphe.huawei.petal.maps).
